sections.heading: 1. Definitions
sections.text: "Change of Control" means any transaction or series of related transactions as a result of which any person or group acquires, directly or indirectly, more than fifty per cent (50%) of the voting securities of the Company or the power to direct its management and policies. sections.heading: 2. Term
sections.text: This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues for 3 years unless terminated earlier in accordance with its terms.

sections.text: The Company shall pay all undisputed invoices within 60 days of receipt. Late amounts bear interest at 1% per month.

sections.heading: 4. Confidentiality
sections.text: Each party shall keep the other party's Confidential Information confidential for 5 years after termination.

sections.heading: 5. Liability
sections.text: Each party's aggregate liability is capped at 1 times the fees paid in the twelve months preceding the claim, save for fraud.

sections.heading: 6. Assignment
sections.text: Neither party may assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party.

sections.heading: 8. Termination
sections.text: Either party may terminate this Agreement for material breach not remedied within 60 days of written notice.

sections.heading: 9. Governing Law
sections.text: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York.

sections.text: "Change of Control" means any transaction or series of related transactions as a result of which any person or group acquires, directly or indirectly, more than fifty per cent (50%) of the voting securities of the Company or the power to direct its management and policies. "Effective Date" means 2019-03-28.

sections.heading: 2. Term
sections.text: This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues for 5 years unless terminated earlier in accordance with its terms.

sections.heading: 3. Fees and Payment
sections.text: The Company shall pay all undisputed invoices within 45 days of receipt. Late amounts bear interest at 1% per month.

sections.heading: 4. Confidentiality
sections.text: Each party shall keep the other party's Confidential Information confidential for 7 years after termination.

sections.heading: 5. Liability
sections.text: Each party's aggregate liability is capped at 2 times the fees paid in the twelve months preceding the claim, save for fraud.

sections.heading: 6. Assignment
sections.text: Neither party may assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party.

sections.heading: 8. Termination
sections.text: Either party may terminate this Agreement for material breach not remedied within 30 days of written notice.

sections.heading: 9. Governing Law
sections.text: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.
